Home.trustTitle: The service should feel helpful without pretending to be EPFO
Home.trustCopy: ClaimSaathi is an independent prototype. It keeps synthetic data, reviewed rules, and uncertainty states visible so citizens can trust the guidance without mistaking it for a live government action.

Audit.title: Why you can trust this check
Audit.deterministic: Decision checks were deterministic. AI was not used to determine this result.
Audit.reviewed: ClaimSaathi used reviewed rules, synthetic records, and versioned configuration supplied by the backend.
Audit.aiGap: AI was not used to fill the policy gap.
Audit.aiBoundary: Optional AI explanation features cannot change this decision state.

History.title: Journey checks

PolicyReview.copy: ClaimSaathi cannot safely determine this journey from the currently reviewed policy configuration. We won't guess when the policy basis is unresolved.
facts: Did not invent a waiting period
Did not use AI to choose between unresolved policy interpretations
Did not claim eligibility or a government outcome
PolicyReview.notReady: Process identification does not mean the journey is currently verified as ready.
PolicyReview.cannotCopy: Whether the currently reviewed policy configuration supports a final eligibility or readiness decision.
PolicyReview.noResolution: No automated resolution is configured for this policy-review state.
PolicyReview.processDescription: This source supports the displayed process label only. It is not being used to resolve the policy uncertainty.
PolicyReview.provenanceDescription: These are only the source identifiers used by evaluated rules. No form-label source is attributed to an unresolved rule.
PolicyReview.noRuleSource: No active reviewed rule source was attached to the unresolved policy marker.
PolicyReview.trustworthyStop: Sometimes a trustworthy system should stop.
PolicyReview.whyCopy: The configured policy evidence for this journey requires review before ClaimSaathi can make a deterministic readiness decision. Policy verification required means the reviewed policy basis needs human or configuration review. It is different from being unable to verify a required trusted record.
PolicyReview.sourcesDescription: These source IDs come from the stored decision. Their presence does not by itself resolve the policy-review state.
PolicyReview.noRuleSourceLong: No rule source is attached to the policy-review marker in this decision. The process metadata source below supports only the identified form label.
PolicyReview.identifiedProcessDescription: This source supports the {form} process label. It does not establish that this journey is ready or resolve the policy-review state.
PolicyReview.reviewDecision: Review how this decision was made

Resolution.howCopy: Fixing a blocker does not rewrite an earlier decision. ClaimSaathi runs all checks again and creates a new decision.

SystemExplorer.title: From form hunting to guided journeys
SystemExplorer.intro: ClaimSaathi starts with what the citizen wants to do, checks the configured prerequisites before exposing the government process, guides blocker resolution, and rechecks the complete journey.
SystemExplorer.boundary: ClaimSaathi identifies and explains the applicable process. It does not perform government actions.
formFirstSteps: Discover the applicable process or form
Leave the process to resolve it
Return and determine what to do next
SystemExplorer.comparisonNote: Simplified comparison for demonstrating the orchestration model. It is not an exhaustive audit of an external government system.
SystemExplorer.systemOrchestrates: The system performs the orchestration while government decisions remain authoritative.
SystemExplorer.changesCopy: These are design improvements in ClaimSaathi, not guarantees about every external government experience.
transformations: See what is blocked and the configured resolution
SystemExplorer.artifactTitle: Reviewed configuration is a system artifact
SystemExplorer.artifactCopy: These artifacts are not generated by an LLM, scraped and activated automatically, or inferred at runtime.
SystemExplorer.syntheticCopy: Demo records are isolated synthetic facts. No live EPFO data or action enters this prototype.
SystemExplorer.traceTitle: See what happens behind the screen
SystemExplorer.traceCopy: Generate a real synthetic journey through the public demo API, then inspect presentation-safe data from its stored deterministic decision. Reading a trace does not run the planner, rules, graph, resolution, or AI.
SystemExplorer.uncertaintyTitle: Safe systems need a way to say: we don't know.
SystemExplorer.unableCopy: Required trusted information is unavailable or cannot be verified.
SystemExplorer.reviewCopy: The configured authoritative policy is unresolved or requires review.
SystemExplorer.stateNote: These are ClaimSaathi system states, not official EPFO status names.
SystemExplorer.aiTitle: Where AI can — and cannot — exist
explanationPath: Optional AI · simplified or Hindi explanation
SystemExplorer.aiCopy: AI is optional and explanation-only. It is called only when a citizen explicitly requests simpler English or Hindi, and the deterministic product continues to work when AI is unavailable.
SystemExplorer.ctaCopy: Start with a citizen goal and follow the same backend truth through a simple guided journey.

arjun.subtitle: Policy uncertainty stops the system safely

Trace.noneCopy: Choose a scenario and generate its trace. Nothing runs automatically.

stageDescriptions.JOURNEY_PLANNER: Reviewed configuration maps the goal to one journey.
stageDescriptions.POLICY_ENGINE: Versioned deterministic rules evaluate trusted inputs.
stageDescriptions.PREREQUISITE_GRAPH: The configured graph combines every prerequisite state.
stageDescriptions.DECISION_RECORD: The immutable result and provenance are stored.

Trace.noFuzzy: No fuzzy matching or model ranking is used.
Trace.goalCopy: ClaimSaathi starts with the citizen's goal rather than asking them to choose a government form.
Trace.storedDecisionCopy: ClaimSaathi records the result as an immutable decision rather than mutating history later.
Trace.decisionInput: Stored deterministic rule and graph results
Trace.priyaEyebrow: Architecture · not the current live trace
Trace.priyaTitle: Resolving one blocker does not rewrite or automatically pass the journey.
Trace.priyaCopy: ClaimSaathi runs every configured rule and prerequisite again and creates a new immutable decision. The full recovery interaction remains in Priya's citizen journey.
priyaSteps: whole journey is not automatically PASS
PASS only after the completed demo flow
